attempts.summary: Configured node1 (a SONiC-VS box) as an L3 router forwarding between node2 and node3 over two point-to-point links (eth1/enp8s0=192.168.12.0/30, eth2/enp8s0=192.168.13.0/30), enabled IP forwarding, and added an nftables forward-hook ACL on node1 that explicitly accepts TCP/8080 and rejects (TCP RST) TCP/23 in both directions between node2 and node3, while leaving the default-accept forward policy untouched for all other traffic (verified with a control port 9999 and ICMP). All config was made persistent (ifupdown drop-in for link IPs, sysctl.d for forwarding, a systemd oneshot service to reapply the nft ACL table on boot; NetworkManager static profiles on node2/node3 for the link IPs and routes). Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and health, rebooted, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the ACL/data path after each restart.
